The '''Experimental Holorecording Macrobinoculars''' was a specialized [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|Macrobinoculars]] device developed by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] technicians. It was capable of recording an image from up to 1000 meters away.

==History==
Prior to its development, recording an image required a jury-rigged link between regular macrobinoculars and [[Holorecorder/Legends|Holorecorders]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]] produced the [[Model TT4 Holorecording Macrobinoculars]].
